items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: The lady bassoon player. Carol. The current Mrs. Jacquet? ... She has been his savior he tells me.

ctx.x: I never got past his wife I think.
Oh yes. The lady bassoon player. Carol. The current Mrs. Jacquet?
I can’t even remember. It’s been a couple of years.
